core_updates.J01.8: Related-record columns show whole chips that fit the column, then +N more; the browser requests up to 20 related records per row, while the API defaults to 3 and allows 1–20; only a single-valued name column can sort.

facts: Mapping PUT checks its set version even for an unchanged save, while a bulk replaceRelationSet reports unchanged before its version claim; callers must use the chosen operation's retry contract.
Decimal values have one canonical representation without trailing zeros and date-times retain their UTC instant and explicit offset in every data context.
A matrix cell previews up to five records and reports its complete count rather than silently truncating it.
A matrix read in the incoming direction does not apply a condition or uniqueness scope defined on the binding's target end, so it has no inactive or conflict state for those rules.

Restructuring offers back only values previously lost through effective reclassifications in the current or published change sets; it does not restore deliberately cleared values or changes from discarded change sets.
A tree drop chooses a parent or hierarchy level, not a manual ordering slot, and several selected records can move together only when their types stay the same.
Related-record columns read only visible columns and show as many whole chips as fit their width; the old fixed three-chip display and five-expansion maximum are superseded.

Consumer events may name an output whose answer is unchanged; identities and full objects are composed when read or delivered, not stored at the change position; deleted objects have no object and null code/name.
A webhook event larger than 1 MiB is sent alone; automatic retries retain event range and delivery ID but recompose current objects, while manual resend uses stored payload.

Counterpart deletes still claim the counterpart version; only upserts, updates and ensureRelation ignore the source file version; counterpart IDs use name-derived SHA-1 bytes marked as UUID version 4.
A cleared workbook cell or relationship list clears nothing; several owned records under one parent make a read-only summary cell rather than an ambiguous write.
A sampled bulk deletion confirms only previewed items; unpreviewed deletes are refused DELETION_PREVIEW_REQUIRED at execution.
A columns-per-parent workbook that needs more than 16,384 columns fails INVALID_EXPORT_LAYOUT when the job runs.
An empty replace-relation cell clears its set after the 0.9 release fix; ordinary blank attribute and owned-record cells still leave values unchanged.
